h1: The 6 Best Wall-Mounted Garden Hose Reels of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Wall Hose Reels 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 6 best wall-mounted garden hose reels of 2026, from a 125 ft Liberty swivel arm to retractable 100 and 130 ft models.
summary: The Liberty Garden 712 Navigator is the pick for long reach, with a multi-directional single arm and 125 feet of hose. The Artigarden triangle reel is the metal-built alternative, and the Giraffe Tools 130 ft retractable is the longest. The NEO-TEC and NEOTEC reels are the mid-priced retractable choices.
intro: The classic hose reel mistake is buying for hose length and forgetting how the reel mounts. A 125 foot reel that swings badly or sits on weak siding will pull away from the wall the first time you tug it.
We ranked six reels from the listing details: hose length, reel type, material and price bucket. We dropped two metal hose holders because they hang a hose but are not reels.

products.name: Liberty GARDEN 712 Single Arm Navigator Multi-Directional Garden Hose Reel
products.verdict: A single swivel arm lets one wall-mounted reel cover a wide area.
products.description:
The Navigator is a single-arm multi-directional reel that holds 125 feet and comes with a hose. It falls in the $100-200 range.

We rank it first because the swivel arm lets you pull hose in several directions from one mounting point. The Artigarden below is cheaper but lists no such arm.

Buy it for a large yard where you pull hose in different directions. The mount still needs a solid wall behind it.
products.idealFor: Large yards pulled in several directions.

products.name: Artigarden Triangle Wall Mounted Garden Hose Reel
products.verdict: A metal triangle reel holding 125 feet for less.
products.description:
The Artigarden is a metal wall-mounted reel in a triangle design for 125 feet of hose, priced in the $50-100 range.

It ranks second because it matches the Navigator's length for less money, though it lacks the swivel arm. Metal construction is its main selling point.

A solid pick for one fixed spot. Hose is separate, so check what is in the box.
products.idealFor: A fixed watering spot with long reach.

products.name: Giraffe Tools Retractable Garden Hose Reel 1/2" 130FT Wall Mount Auto
products.verdict: The longest hose here, in a retractable wall-mount.
products.description:
This reel is an auto-retractable wall-mount model with 130 feet of half-inch hose, in the $100-200 range.

It places third because retractable mechanisms add moving parts, though the extra length is the best on this list.

Ideal for long runs with minimal winding by hand. Check that the spring retracts smoothly before you rely on it.

products.name: NEO-TEC Upgraded Retractable Garden Hose Reel 5/8 inch x 100 ft Wall-Mounted
products.verdict: A thicker 5/8 inch rubber hose on a 100 ft retractable reel.
products.description:
The NEO-TEC upgraded reel is a retractable wall-mounted model with 100 feet of 5/8 inch hose, listed as rubber, in the $50-100 range.

It ranks fourth because the wider hose moves more water, but 100 feet is shorter than the top three.

Best where flow matters. Rubber hoses can feel heavier to handle.
products.idealFor: Users who want stronger water flow.

products.name: NEOTEC 100FT Retractable Garden Hose Reel 1/2 Inch
products.verdict: A 100 ft half-inch retractable reel in the middle of the price range.
products.description:
The NEOTEC is a retractable reel with 100 feet of half-inch hose, listed at $50-100.

It lands fifth because it is the narrower-hose sibling of the NEO-TEC upgraded model. It is lighter to handle.

A fit for small to medium yards. Check your flow needs first.

products.name: glahoden Retractable Garden Hose Reel
products.verdict: A metal retractable reel with 100 feet of hose.
products.description:
The glahoden is a metal retractable reel with 100 feet of hose, listed at $100-200.

It ranks last because it costs as much as longer rivals and shows few other details.

Choose it for metal construction. Caveat: weigh the price against the longer options above.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a metal retractable.

methodology.title: Hose length
methodology.description: We compared 100, 125 and 130 foot capacities against yard sizes.

methodology.title: Reel type
methodology.description: Retractable, swivel-arm and fixed triangle designs were weighed.

methodology.title: Material
methodology.description: Metal and rubber builds were noted where listed.

methodology.title: Hose diameter
methodology.description: Half-inch and 5/8 inch hoses were compared for flow and weight.

methodology.title: Price bracket
methodology.description: Each reel was judged against its bucket.

whatMatters.detail: Length decides how far you can reach. Longer is heavier on the wall. Measure the farthest spot you water and add a margin.
A 5/8 inch hose carries more water than a half-inch one but weighs more. This matters for flow. Check the diameter in the title.
Retractable reels wind themselves via a spring, saving effort. Springs can wear. Look for retractable or auto in the title.
A reel plus a full hose is heavy. It must go into studs or masonry, not thin siding. Check hardware in the listing.
A swivel arm lets you pull hose in several directions. It matters in odd-shaped yards. Look for multi-directional.

howToChoose.intro: Match hose length to how far you need to reach.

cards.label: Retractable
cards.text: Winds itself. Giraffe Tools, NEO-TEC, NEOTEC and glahoden.

cards.label: Fixed or swivel
cards.text: Simpler mechanics. Liberty Navigator and Artigarden Triangle.

howToChoose.note: Most buyers should default to retractable for convenience, and fixed if reliability matters.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The Liberty Navigator is the multi-directional pick.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want swivel or the longest reach. The Navigator and Giraffe justify it.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You have a fixed watering spot. The Artigarden is cheaper.

faq.q: Where should I mount a reel?
faq.a: Into studs or masonry near your spigot, away from thin siding.
Buying a long hose and mounting on a weak surface.

faq.q: Is retractable worth it over manual?
faq.a: It saves winding effort but has a spring that can wear.

faq.q: How do I set up a reel?
faq.a: Mount the bracket, connect to the spigot and run the hose out.
Drain water before storing and keep the hose clean in cold weather.
The Navigator lists a reel with hose. Check others.

finalTake: The Liberty Navigator is the best reel for large or odd-shaped yards. The Artigarden is the value pick for a fixed spot. Choose the Giraffe if you need the longest reach.
